title: Careers at Bloom — teach with former IELTS examiners
meta_description: Open roles for examiners, teachers and academic staff across Bengaluru, Muscat, Milan and Shanghai. You specialise in one part of the exam and you mark it properly.

props.heading: Pursue your career with us.
props.body: We are a small academy with an unusual standard: every teacher marks one part of the exam for a living. If you are a former examiner, a specialist tutor or someone who wants education operations done properly, we want to hear from you.

props.heading: What the job is actually like.
props.lead: No inflated claims. This is how the academy runs, and the parts people tell us they value.

features.title: You specialise
features.body: Nobody here teaches all four skills. You own one part of the exam and become the person the others come to about it.

features.title: Small cohorts
features.body: Ten to eighteen students, never more. You know every name and every weakness by week two.

features.title: 48-hour marking
features.body: It is a standard, not an aspiration. In return, marking time is timetabled — you are not doing it at midnight.

features.title: Four time zones
features.body: Bengaluru, Muscat, Milan and Shanghai. Remote and hybrid contracts are normal, not a concession.

features.title: Recognition on record
features.body: Best Faculty is quarterly and measured on student band gain, not popularity. It comes with a certificate and a revision.

features.title: Paid development
features.body: DELTA, examiner training and conference attendance are funded, with study leave to sit the exams.

props.heading: Roles we are hiring for.
props.lead: Apply below and your application enters our hiring pipeline the same minute. We read every one, and reply either way.

jobs.title: IELTS Writing Examiner
jobs.need: Former examiner, five years minimum, able to mark against all four descriptors.

jobs.title: Speaking Tutor · Gulf
jobs.need: Arabic-speaking, strong on pronunciation for Arabic L1 learners.

jobs.title: Admissions Counsellor
jobs.need: Two years in overseas education counselling; UK and Australia pathways.

empty.heading: No roles open right now
empty.body: We hire on need rather than on a calendar. Send a speculative application and we will come back to you when something opens.

props.heading: Six stages, no ghosting.
props.lead: You will know which stage you are at, and roughly how long the next one takes.

steps.title: Applied
steps.body: We confirm receipt the same day.

steps.title: Screening
steps.body: A look at your experience and qualifications. Two to three days.

steps.title: Demo lesson
steps.body: Teaching roles only. Forty-five minutes with real students.

steps.title: Interview
steps.body: With the Operational Leader and the relevant department head.

steps.title: Offer
steps.body: Written offer, terms and start date. Valid fourteen days.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.body: Contract, induction, and a named mentor for your first term.

props.heading: Send us your application.
props.lead: Pick a role, or send a speculative application and we will keep you on file. Everything here goes straight into our hiring pipeline — no third-party job board in between.

tips.title: Name the exam part you want to own
Tell us a number
tips.body: A band gain, a cohort size, a pass rate. Specifics are persuasive.

tips.title: Say where you can teach from
tips.body: Which office, or which time zone if remote.

tips.title: Mention your examiner status
tips.body: Current, lapsed, or never — all three are fine, we just need to know.

props.note: Not seeing your role? Send a speculative application anyway. Three of our current team joined that way — we hold applications on file and come back to them when a vacancy opens.
props.footnote: We confirm receipt the same day and reply either way.

success.title: Application received
success.body: Your application is in our hiring pipeline at the Applied stage. We will be in touch within two working days.
